Header: Helicoverpa armigera Vernacular Name: kai puzhu.

Prevention: Deep summer ploughing (30 cm) to expose pupae present in the soil.
Crop rotation with non host crops like paddy and
Lady bird beetle, Ground beetle, Praying mantis, Pentatomid bug, etc.
Installation of light traps 1/acre of land.
Monitoring: Observe for the defoliation of leaves from 20 to 35 days.
Observe for green coloured larva with black band laterally on leaves.
Later the larvae move on to flowers and fruits.
Observe for bored fruits with round holes.
Notice the larvae thrust their head inside the pod leaving the body outside.
Monitor the economic threshold level up to 10% of affected pods.
Observe for warm weather condition followed by light rains and dry spells which is favourable for pest.
Direct Control: Kernel powder @ 50g/ litre of water or
Oil @ 30 ml/litre twice at the time of flowering and early pod formation stage.
Restrictions: Chlorotraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 40 ml/ acre during flowering stage.
U/IV (Unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use)
Emmamectin benzoate is not classified by
WHO but is considered highly toxic and should be used with care
